candidates.label: Identity-Preserving Refinement
candidates.designThesis: TL2 preserves the distinct TL1 weapon roles while refining structure, field capacity, fire control, guidance, and logistics toward an approximately 60/40 complete-package advantage over TL1. Retained here as the paired source control for attribution; it is not promoted by Checkpoint 44.
namingReview: Coil Cannon remains short-ranged relative to the Pulselaser family so the TL3 Rail Cannon can own the low-tech range/velocity culmination.
Pulsed Laser Cannon improves beam steering and accuracy without matching kinetic raw packet damage.
Fusion Missile Flight improves guidance, speed, endurance, and magazine depth without increasing the TL1 warhead packet.

candidates.label: Moderated Control Refinement
candidates.designThesis: Retains the complete identity package but replaces the five-point global targeting step with a smaller two-point control refinement and a one-point effective PDS improvement.
namingReview: Diagnostic profile only; component names do not imply promotion.
